name: missing-tx-power
prompt: I'm building a link budget calculator for a satellite but I don't have the actual transmit power specs yet—the spacecraft team hasn't finalized the design. I need to make progress on the ground station. What should I do?

name: undefined-crc-failure-behavior
prompt: I'm implementing a command uplink system. The protocol spec says to validate CRC on received commands, but it doesn't say what to do if the CRC fails on a critical command (e.g., initiate safe mode). Should I reject it, retry, or execute anyway? The spec is silent on this.
